plays.desc_ko: 미드 라인전에서 Saint(아칼리)가 일렉트로큐션 발동으로 상대 미드에게 큰 체력 손실을 입힌 짧은 교전.
plays.desc_en: In a brief mid lane skirmish, Saint (Akali) procs Electrocute to deal heavy damage to the opposing mid laner.
plays.quote: Good chunk there from Saint on the ... electric queue proc.

plays.desc_ko: 봇 라인에서 GEN 바텀 듀오(애쉬·세라핀)와의 교환 이후 Berserker가 타워 아래에서 CS를 챙겨야 하는 상황으로 몰림. 라인 압박.
plays.desc_en: After trades with GEN's bot duo of Ruler (Ashe) and Duro (Seraphine), Berserker (Yunara) is forced to farm under his tower.
plays.quote: Bot side though is what I kind of am a ... little bit worried about after the ... Berserker could still

plays.desc_ko: 정글러 둘이 각자 서포트 쪽으로 이동하는 가운데 Inspired가 봇으로 넘어가려다 다시 탑으로 돌아감. Canyon이 Inspired를 밀어내지만 Inspired는 바위게를 나눠 가짐.
plays.desc_en: As both junglers path toward their supports, Inspired (Vi) starts heading bot before turning back top. Canyon (Nocturne) pushes him out, but Inspired still splits the Scuttle Crab.
plays.quote: And now Inspired, Canyon facing off ... Canyon's ... going to be able to push him off that

plays.desc_ko: 봇 라인에서 한 쪽 듀오가 웨이브를 타워에 밀어 넣고(크래시) 귀환 후 복귀(바운스 백)함.
plays.desc_en: One bot duo crashes the wave into the tower, recalls, and bounces back to lane.
plays.quote: vibing as well. They get the crash. They ... get the bounce back. They should be

plays.desc_ko: Saint가 미드 첫 푸시 때 설치한 와드와 칼날부리 와드로 Canyon(녹턴)의 동선을 포착, LYON이 위험 핑을 찍으며 대비.
plays.desc_en: Using a ward placed on his first mid push and a raptor ward, Saint (Akali) spots Canyon (Nocturne)'s pathing, and LYON pings danger to prepare.
plays.quote: When Saint had that first ... push in the mid lane, does drop a ward ... good red pings here. You see the pings

plays.desc_ko: GEN이 첫 드래곤을 획득. Canyon이 스마이트 싸움에서 이겼고, Kiin은 텔레포트로 교전에 합류.
plays.desc_en: GEN takes the first dragon as Canyon (Nocturne) wins the Smite battle and Kiin (Ambessa) joins the fight via Teleport.
plays.quote: They're able to grab it. ... DRAKE IN FAVOR OF GEN.G ... the teleport comes

plays.desc_ko: 드래곤 근처 교전에서 Saint가 진입, Canyon의 주문 보호막을 기다렸다가 콤보를 넣고 Duro를 마무리. Dhokla가 쉔 궁극기로 합류. 이후 수리검 표식을 이용해 추가 킬까지 획득. 드래곤은 GEN, 교전은 LYON.
plays.desc_en: Saint (Akali) dives in, waits out Canyon's Shroud of Darkness, then combos to finish Duro (Seraphine) as Dhokla (Shen) joins with Stand United. LYON uses the Shuriken Flip mark for another kill: GEN gets the dragon, LYON wins the fight.
plays.quote: Dash in from Saint. ... HOPING TO BURN DOWN CANYON. FINISHES OFF ... DURO.

plays.title_ko: 탑 텔포 복귀 후 라인 푸시
plays.desc_ko: 교전 후 Dhokla가 탑으로 텔레포트해 복귀, 라인을 밀어 넣음. Kiin은 텔레포트를 이미 사용해 쉔이 크로스맵 이득을 봄.
plays.desc_en: After the fight, Dhokla (Shen) teleports back top and shoves the wave, gaining cross-map value since Kiin (Ambessa) has already used Teleport.
plays.quote: teleport back to top side now for Dokla. ... Shen has the plus one on cross map play ... Uh does get the shove

plays.desc_ko: 유충 앞 탑 사이드 교전. LYON 전원이 위로 이동, Dhokla가 걸어와 플래시 진입으로 Chovy를 묶고 폴리모프까지 이어감. Chovy는 자기 궁극기(얼음 무덤)로 버팀. Canyon이 팀 한가운데 잡혀 처치됨.
plays.desc_en: In a top-side fight before grubs, LYON moves up together; Dhokla (Shen) walks in and Flashes to lock down Chovy (Lissandra), followed by Isles' Whimsy polymorph. Chovy holds on with Frozen Tomb, but Canyon (Nocturne) gets caught in the middle of LYON and dies.
plays.quote: Oh, we're fighting all right. ... walked over now. ... lock him up on the Jobi

plays.desc_ko: 봇에 있던 Kiin이 먼저 도착해 궁극기로 합류, Saint를 처치. Duro의 장거리 궁극기, Ruler의 딜 교환이 이어지고 Chovy는 걸어서 생존. GEN이 교전을 뒤집음.
plays.desc_en: Kiin (Ambessa) arrives first from bot and uses his ultimate to kill Saint (Akali). Duro (Seraphine)'s long-range Encore and Ruler (Ashe)'s damage follow while Chovy (Lissandra) walks out alive, and GEN turns the fight.
plays.quote: ULTI FROM DORAN AT LONG RANGE. ... ULTI RIGHT IN THE NICK OF TIME COMING IN ... FOR KEEN.

plays.desc_ko: Inspired가 라인 주도권 없이 유충 하나를 몰래 가져가려 시도했으나 Canyon이 이미 맵에 있어 아무것도 훔치지 못함.
plays.desc_en: Without lane priority, Inspired (Vi) tries to sneak a grub, but Canyon (Nocturne) is already on the map and he steals nothing.
plays.quote: Inspired a bit aggressive ... just get in, sneak away a cheeky grub, ... Inspired not going to be able to steal

plays.desc_ko: Canyon이 진입해 유충을 확보, 드래곤에 이어 두 중립 오브젝트 모두 GEN이 가져감.
plays.desc_en: Canyon (Nocturne) moves in to secure the grubs, giving GEN both neutral objectives after the dragon.
plays.quote: Canyon moves in, as you ... say, that'll be both neutral objectives ... taken now for Gen.G

plays.desc_ko: 미드 1대1에서 Chovy가 얼음 길(E)을 써서 Saint의 재진입을 위협, 들어오면 타워 아래라는 압박을 줌.
plays.desc_en: In the mid 1v1, Chovy (Lissandra) uses Glacial Path to threaten Saint (Akali)'s re-engage, warning that coming in means fighting under tower.
plays.quote: Okay in the one V one. ... Frozen Path there from Chovy just to ... threaten.

plays.desc_ko: GEN이 용 둥지 뒤로 돌아 들어가 시야를 잡고, Canyon의 녹턴 궁극기와 스턴으로 Inspired를 6초간 묶어 처치. Kiin도 텔레포트로 합류. 체력 1 남은 드래곤을 스마이트 싸움 끝에 확보(두 번째 드래곤).
plays.desc_en: GEN circles behind the dragon pit for vision, and Canyon (Nocturne) chains Paranoia and Unspeakable Horror to lock Inspired (Vi) for six seconds and kill him as Kiin (Ambessa) teleports in. GEN wins a Smite battle on a 1-HP dragon for their second drake.
plays.quote: Gen.G trying to move over behind ... the pit, wrapping around. ... That's the Nocturne ultimate.

plays.desc_ko: LYON이 두 번째 드래곤을 견제. Saint가 체력이 깎인 상태로 다시 대시 진입, Inspired는 스마이트 싸움을 시도했지만 군중제어에 묶여 탈출 못함. Dhokla의 지원(궁극기/텔레포트)은 녹턴 궁극기로 무력화.
plays.desc_en: LYON contests the second dragon: a damaged Saint (Akali) dashes back in, Inspired (Vi) tries to Smite but can't escape crowd control, and Dhokla (Shen)'s Stand United/Teleport support is neutralized by Nocturne's Paranoia.
plays.quote: They do see Saint. ... Has been chunked out. Dash back in. ... Hoping to queue out,

plays.desc_ko: 드래곤을 내주는 대신 Dhokla가 탑 사이드에서 타워 압박으로 교환 시도, 웨이브를 밀어 넣음.
plays.desc_en: Giving up the dragon, Dhokla (Shen) tries to trade by pressuring the top-side tower and shoving the wave.
plays.quote: Dopa at least ... will trade a turret play on the top side ... and pushing that one in.

plays.desc_ko: Kiin이 아칼리 장막을 뚫고 Saint를 찾다가, Dhokla가 합류하자 Kiin과 Chovy가 부시에서 받아쳐 두 킬을 획득.
plays.desc_en: Kiin (Ambessa) pushes through Akali's Twilight Shroud hunting Saint, and when Dhokla (Shen) arrives, Kiin and Chovy (Lissandra) counter from the brush for two kills.
plays.quote: Keen starts to tear through that shroud. ... Hoping to find Saint. ... BUT, KEEN IS THERE, TOO.

plays.desc_ko: Saint가 부시 쪽으로 진입했다가 수리검 플립으로 빠지려 하고, Dhokla가 궁극기로 기습 합류를 노림. Saint가 과하게 들어가 GEN의 군중제어에 걸림.
plays.desc_en: Saint (Akali) dives toward the brush and tries to escape with Shuriken Flip while Dhokla (Shen) looks to flank with Stand United, but Saint overcommits and gets caught by GEN's crowd control.
plays.quote: Dash back with a shuriken flip. ... is there as Dopa now TRIES TO GET ... Saint oversteps

plays.desc_ko: Saint가 Chovy와 짧은 딜 교환으로 체력을 깎으며 후속 플레이를 노리고, Inspired가 Chovy를 노리고 접근했으나 Kiin이 뒤따르고 Ruler의 장거리 이니시 위협 때문에 Inspired가 물러남.
plays.desc_en: Saint (Akali) chips Chovy (Lissandra) in a short trade to set up a play, and Inspired (Vi) approaches, but backs off as Kiin (Ambessa) follows and Ruler (Ashe)'s long-range engage looms.
plays.quote: A little trade here from Saint and ... He's softening them up to see if they ... Inspired's coming

plays.desc_ko: 위협이 걷힌 뒤 Chovy가 귀환해 풀체력으로 라인에 복귀.
plays.desc_en: With the threat gone, Chovy (Lissandra) recalls and returns to lane at full health.
plays.quote: going to reset here ... So, Chovy comes back full.

plays.desc_ko: 탑에서 Kiin이 서두르지 않고 큰 피해를 넣어 Dhokla를 몰아붙이고 결국 솔로킬. LYON 다수를 끌어들인 뒤 플래시와 녹턴 어둠을 이용해 도주를 시도했으나 결국 처치됨.
plays.desc_en: Kiin (Ambessa) patiently deals heavy damage to Dhokla (Shen) for a solo kill, then draws multiple LYON members and tries to escape using Flash and Nocturne's Paranoia, but is eventually taken down.
plays.quote: Dovah's in trouble. Big ... damage coming in from Keen, really ... BUT KEEN ALREADY GETS

plays.desc_ko: LYON이 탑으로 몰려와 Kiin을 덮침. Dhokla 도발이 간신히 맞고 Inspired가 후속, 궁극기들이 들어가며 Kiin의 도주를 막고 현상금 킬을 획득.
plays.desc_en: LYON collapses top on Kiin (Ambessa); Dhokla (Shen)'s Shadow Dash taunt barely lands, Inspired (Vi) follows up, and their ultimates stop Kiin's escape for a bounty kill.
plays.quote: The lion now here to cover. ... Keen trying to make it out. ... barely clipping him. Inspired looking

plays.desc_ko: 탑 교전 동안 GEN이 전령을 가져가 즉시 미드에 사용, 다이브로 Berserker(유나라)를 처치하고 미드 타워를 철거.
plays.desc_en: During the top fight, GEN takes the Herald and uses it mid immediately, diving to kill Berserker (Yunara) and destroy the mid tower.
plays.quote: IN THE MID LANE, ... BERSERKER IS FALLING. ... GEN.G TOWERING through mid.

plays.desc_ko: GEN이 세 번째 드래곤을 준비하자 Inspired가 바로 각을 보고 교전을 열고 Dhokla가 진입했으나 Canyon이 플래시로 즉시 빠져나감. 많은 스킬을 쓰고 플래시 하나만 뺌.
plays.desc_en: As GEN sets up the third dragon, Inspired (Vi) spots an angle and opens the fight with Dhokla (Shen) diving in, but Canyon (Nocturne) Flashes out instantly. LYON spends many abilities for just one Flash.
plays.quote: immediately is going to pull the trigger ... Dokla goes in. Canyon ... flashes right back out.

plays.desc_ko: Kiin이 텔레포트로 합류, LYON이 물러나는 듯했으나 Kiin이 다시 진입해 Dhokla의 플래시를 빼고 Ruler가 화살로 후속.
plays.desc_en: Kiin (Ambessa) teleports in, and as LYON seems to back off, he re-engages to burn Dhokla (Shen)'s Flash while Ruler (Ashe) follows with Enchanted Crystal Arrow.
plays.quote: Keen ... teleporting in. ... KEEN'S GOING

plays.desc_ko: 교전 우위를 바탕으로 GEN이 세 번째 드래곤을 획득.
plays.desc_en: Riding the fight advantage, GEN takes the third dragon.
plays.quote: That is their dragon for ... GenG taking the ... drake, taking the objectives

plays.desc_ko: Kiin이 해당 사이드 LYON 외곽 타워를 철거, 다음 드래곤 접근로를 위험하게 만듦.
plays.desc_en: Kiin (Ambessa) destroys LYON's outer tower on that side, making the approach to the next dragon dangerous for them.
plays.quote: Keen also taking ... down the last little bit of defense that ... the outer tower on spot side also going

plays.desc_ko: LYON이 Canyon을 잡으려 시도. Saint가 스킬을 잘 피했지만 킬을 마무리하지 못했고, 이어진 화살 등 마지막 시도도 아무 이득 없이 끝남.
plays.desc_en: LYON tries to catch Canyon (Nocturne); Saint (Akali) dodges skills well but can't finish the kill, and the final attempts, including an arrow, gain nothing.
plays.quote: take Canyon out. A nice side step from ... Saint, but he can't even finish the ... And now the arrow to follow, the

plays.desc_ko: LYON이 재시도해 Kiin을 폴리모프로 묶고 버튼 하나 누르기 전에 체력을 모두 깎음. 다른 곳에 GEN 압박이 없어 Kiin 혼자 라인을 밀던 상황.
plays.desc_en: LYON tries again, polymorphing Kiin (Ambessa) with Isles (Lulu)'s Whimsy and deleting him before he can press a button while he pushed alone with no other GEN pressure.
plays.quote: Polymorph Keen. Tear ... through his entire HEALTH OF ALL BEFORE ... HE CAN PUSH A SINGLE BUTTON.

plays.desc_ko: Canyon이 Inspired 쪽으로 접근했으나 Inspired가 먼저 발견, 녹턴 공포 연결이 끊기고 Inspired는 레드 버프를 챙김.
plays.desc_en: Canyon (Nocturne) approaches Inspired (Vi), but Inspired spots him first, breaks the Unspeakable Horror tether, and takes the red buff.
plays.quote: Wait a second. Uh-oh. ... Canyon on the way. ... Spired spots him out. The fear tether

plays.desc_ko: 누군가가 대시로 빠져나가며 상대 궁극기를 회피, 시전 애니메이션은 나갔으나 목숨은 지킴.
plays.desc_en: Someone dashes away to dodge an enemy ultimate; the cast animation goes off, but they survive.
plays.quote: Able to dash out. Cast animation still ... goes through, but won't cost him his ... life.

plays.desc_ko: 탑/바론 지역 한타. Kiin 궁극기는 빗나갔지만 Ruler 화살이 즉시 적중, Chovy가 측면으로 들어가 팀 한가운데 대시. Chovy가 잡힌 뒤에도 Ruler가 최전방에서 거리를 관리하고 GEN이 라인을 지켜 승리, LYON은 Saint만 생존.
plays.desc_en: In a top/Baron teamfight, Kiin (Ambessa)'s ultimate misses but Ruler (Ashe)'s arrow lands immediately and Chovy (Lissandra) flanks into LYON's backline. After Chovy falls, Ruler kites at the front and GEN holds the line to win, leaving only Saint alive for LYON.
plays.quote: Keen's ulti isn't going ... arrow connects immediately. ... Chovy though on the flank.

plays.desc_ko: LYON이 진입한 Chovy를 폴리모프와 CC 연계로 즉시 잡아 현상금을 획득. 이후 Dhokla의 3인 도발과 플래시 진입, Berserker 궁극기로 역전을 노렸으나 딜이 부족했고 GEN의 거리 관리에 막힘.
plays.desc_en: LYON catches the diving Chovy (Lissandra) with Isles (Lulu)'s polymorph and CC chain for a bounty, then Dhokla (Shen) taunts three with a Flash engage and Berserker (Yunara) ults to turn it, but lacks damage and is stopped by GEN's spacing.
plays.quote: Polymorph proto-belt tries to take him ... THAT'S THE SHUT DOWN. ... THREE-MAN TALKING TO YOU

plays.desc_ko: 한타 승리 후 GEN이 바론을 획득하고 LYON 본진 앞까지 진출.
plays.desc_en: After winning the fight, GEN takes Baron and pushes up to LYON's base.
plays.quote: BE THEM ON THE BARON. ... Gen.G with the ... Baron now at the gates of Lion's base.

plays.desc_ko: 바론 이후 Kiin이 1-4 운영으로 미드 라인 압박을 유지.
plays.desc_en: After Baron, Kiin (Ambessa) runs a 1-4 setup while GEN keeps pressure on mid lane.
plays.quote: Keane trying to keep pressure up in the ... mid lane. ... The 1-4.

plays.desc_ko: GEN이 무리하지 않고 바론 버프 웨이브를 기다렸다가 진격. 화살 적중, 타워 하나 철거, Kiin이 최전방. Chovy가 플래시로 진입하고 Duro가 즉시 후속, 마지막 교전을 이기고 2세트 승리.
plays.desc_en: GEN patiently waits for a Baron-empowered wave before advancing, landing an arrow and taking a tower with Kiin (Ambessa) in front. Chovy (Lissandra) Flashes in, Duro (Seraphine) follows instantly, and GEN wins the final fight to take Game 2.
plays.quote: Waiting for their next ... Two minion waves buffed up. ... Arrow connecting.

plays.desc_ko: 본진 방어 중 Dhokla 도발이 적중하고 Inspired가 Chovy에게 돌진, Saint는 골든(무적) 상태로 버텼으나 별다른 효과가 없었음.
plays.desc_en: Defending their base, Dhokla (Shen) lands a taunt and Inspired (Vi) dives Chovy (Lissandra), while Saint (Akali) survives in Zhonya's stasis, but it has little effect.
plays.quote: Taunt connecting. Chovy getting charged ... up by Inspired. ... SAINT GOES GOLDEN, BUT IT
